Your holdings: Your leveraged chip positions are bleeding hard; SOXL is down -74.63%, MUU -57.76%, and SMCI -33.74%. Given you're on margin, these drawdowns are amplified and demand immediate attention.

plays: Respect stops on leveraged chip ETFs: SOXL is down -74.63%, MUU -57.76%. Consider tightening stops or reducing exposure to these highly volatile, decaying assets, especially with chip sector headwinds.
Consider trimming CRWD: It's a winner at +31.08% and marked "TRIM." Take some profits to reduce overall portfolio risk and free up margin.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market uncertainty from the Nvidia news makes new long positions risky, despite some scanner setups.
